question: Choose the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**his**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes a sniffer dog named Tucker.
 
• The possessive pronoun "his" is used for male animals and fits the context of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, using "his" correctly refers to Tucker and aligns with the context of the sentence.
 
• Other options like "its," "him," and "her" are not appropriate in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Sniffer dog Tucker uses his__ nose to help researchers find out why a killer whale population off the northwest coast of the United States is **_________**the decline. He searches for whale faeces floating on the surface of the water, which are then collected for examination. He is one of the elite team members of detection dogs used by scientists studying a **_________**of species including right whales and killer whales.* ​*Conservation canines are fast becoming indispensable tools for biologists according to Aimee Hurt, associate director and co-founder of Working Dogs for Conservation, **_________**in Three Forks, Montana. Over the last few years, though, so many new conservation dog projects have sprung up that Hurt can no **_________**keep track of them all. Her organisation’s dogs and their handlers are fully booked to assist field researchers into 2012.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Its (इसका): Although "its" can be used for animals, it is more impersonal and less appropriate as Tucker is named and described in detail.
 
• Him (उसे): "Him" is an objective pronoun and does not fit the possessive context required here.
 
• Her (उसकी): "Her" is a possessive pronoun but inappropriate as it denotes female gender.
